failed: Failed. The Nightmare keeps what you could not carry out of it.
Failed. The Spell has seen your end in this dream, and it will not forget it.
poor: Poor. You lived, and little else.
Poor. The Spell expected more from a soul of your rank.

poor.text: Poor. Mercy is not the same as weakness, but tonight it looked like it.

adequate: Adequate. You did what the Nightmare asked, and nothing it did not.
Adequate. Enough to be remembered for a day.
good: Good. The Nightmare bent where you pushed it.
Good. The threads of this dream remember your weight.
excellent: Excellent. Few who walk this Nightmare leave it in such order.
Excellent. The Spell takes note of you.
glorious: Glorious. The Spell will remember this.

glorious.text: Glorious. Your treachery truly knows no bounds.
Glorious. You walked it alone, and the dream could not hold you.

impossible: You have achieved the impossible. Even the Spell did not foresee this.
